title: A branching model for selective sweeps
summary: At every discrete time i we introduce exactly one individual whose genotype is given by a p_i sampled uniformly in (0,1). This individual will be the founder of a branching process with a geometric offspring distribution with parameter p_i. All the branching processes are independent. We show that as time goes to infinity successive selective sweeps occur. That is, ever more fit single genotypes dominate the population.
